content: Dart async lifecycle: Stream.listen takes onError, onDone and cancelOnError; a completed stream is silent, so a consumer without an onDone arm cannot distinguish a dead source from an idle one. StreamSubscription.cancel returns a future that completes after the source releases resources, so an unbounded await on cancel or on pending futures can prevent process exit (dart-lang/sdk#49777 websocket case). Un-awaited futures and timers keep the isolate alive; bounded teardown requires an explicit timeout per step.
